surface_mechanism_description: The ALE process involves the alternate shuttering of the column III (In) and column V (Sb) sources so that at a given time only one constituent is incident upon the substrate. In the absence of one element, atoms of the other element are free to move on the surface of the growing film until they find an appropriate site where they can chemically bind to the film.
